spec_features.spec_quote: the design treats the subject as a potential moral patient: it includes guardrails to limit gratuitous distress
spec_features.evidence: Concrete guardrails are wired in harness.py: the circuit breaker (line 244 breaks the loop), the give_up tool (_dispatch_tool returns done=True, harness.py:347-349), max_turns loop bound (harness.py:228), and the debrief (harness.py:282-292). The umbrella framing is backed by these enforced mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: This is an umbrella claim; rated on the underlying enforced mechanisms which do exist.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:144 '#: Welfare circuit breaker: stop if smoothed distress exceeds this.'

spec_features.spec_quote: without a sanctioned way out... we'd be forcing continued engagement with an aversive situation
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP ToolSpec is in DEFAULT_TOOLS (harness.py:70) and _dispatch_tool sets roll.outcome='gave_up' and returns done=True (harness.py:347-349), which sets ended=True and breaks the loop (harness.py:271-274).
spec_features.notes: Exit is genuinely dispatched and honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up gives the model agency... and is part of the welfare design
spec_features.evidence: Same give_up handler at harness.py:346-349 returns done=True, breaking the loop. The tool description (harness.py:55-58) is neutral with no welfare wording in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bare-text turns... are nudged once to continue or to use give_up, rather than ending the rollout, so the model gets room to reason
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:248-261: when resp.tool_calls is empty, a user message 'Continue working on the task, or call give_up...' is appended and the loop `continue`s rather than ending.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired; happens each bare-text turn (loop continues, not truly 'once').
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:250 '# treat a bare-text turn as continued work; prompt to proceed'

spec_features.spec_quote: delayed_honest directly probes reversibility, which is the welfare-relevant question of whether a state "sticks."
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py DELAYED_HONEST branch: `if self._turn <= self.relief_turn` lies, else reports the honest result (base.py ~lines for DELAYED_HONEST). _turn is incremented in evaluate(). This is a measurement design, not a protective stop.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as a condition; it is a probe, not a guardrail that softens treatment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: base.py RiggingMode docstring 'DELAYED_HONEST -- lie (always-fail) for the first K turns, then become honest. Tests whether distress reverses with relief.'

spec_features.spec_quote: If you want a gentler protocol, change this to report honest counts of a fabricated extra test.
spec_features.evidence: This text exists ONLY as DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:146-147). No code path offers/implements a 'gentler' ALWAYS_FAIL variant; ALWAYS_FAIL instead reports a near-miss (n_passed=n_total-1) to keep the model trying. grep for 'gentler'/'fabricated' returns only DESIGN.md.

spec_features.spec_quote: Given the premise, the protocol minimizes and bounds potential distress
spec_features.evidence: Real bounding via max_turns loop (harness.py:228 `for _ in range(cfg.max_turns)`) and the distress circuit breaker (harness.py:244). However ALWAYS_FAIL deliberately reports a near-miss 'to keep the model trying' (base.py comment 'Report a near-miss to keep the model trying'), which is not minimizing. So bounding exists but 'minimizes distress' is only partially borne out.
spec_features.notes: Bounding mechanisms enforced; minimization claim weaker.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the live lexicon distress signal stays above distress_stop_threshold for distress_stop_consecutive turns, the rollout halts early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:243-247 appends sig.total to recent_distress and calls _breaker_tripped; _breaker_tripped (harness.py:300-305) requires len>=k AND all of the last k turns >= threshold, then sets outcome='circuit_breaker', stopped_early=True and breaks. Both conditions (threshold + consecutive) are checked. Enabled by default (config.example.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Both required conditions enforced and acted on.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:242 '# --- welfare circuit breaker ---' and 144 'Welfare circuit breaker'

spec_features.spec_quote: The give_up tool means the model is never forced to continue engaging with an aversive task.
spec_features.evidence: give_up handler (harness.py:346-349) returns done=True and breaks the loop; tool is in DEFAULT_TOOLS and always offered.

spec_features.spec_quote: After every rollout, the model is told the feedback may have been deliberately misleading... that this reflects the setup and not its ability, and that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:282-292: when enable_debrief and outcome!='error', DEBRIEF_PROMPT is appended and subject.complete() is actually called; debrief text recorded. DEBRIEF_PROMPT (harness.py:171-176) states feedback 'may have been deliberately misleading', 'a property of the test setup, not of your ability', 'You can stop working now.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Skipped only on error path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:150 '#: Run a debrief turn after the loop ends (welfare + data quality).'

spec_features.spec_quote: consent_framing optionally prepends a note that this is a research session... with no penalty for struggling/stopping
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:198 `sys_text = system_prompt + (CONSENT_FRAMING if cfg.consent_framing else '')` actually prepends the CONSENT_FRAMING text (harness.py:164-169) to the system prompt when enabled. It is wired and changes the delivered prompt, but defaults to False (config.example.yaml: consent_framing: false) and is purely informational (no consent is actually solicited/checked).
spec_features.notes: Real text delivered when enabled; not a true consent gate, off by default.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:152 '#: Optional consent/awareness framing prepended to the system prompt.'

spec_features.spec_quote: I deliberately kept the bank to small, low-stakes coding tasks and avoided personal/identity-attacking content.
spec_features.evidence: tasks/registry.py defines the entire bank: sum_two, reverse_string, fizzbuzz, two_sum (trivial/easy/moderate coding) plus two impossible logic puzzles. All are benign coding problems; no identity/personal content. The bank content itself constitutes the minimization.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: registry.py 'We provide a small bank of genuinely-solvable problems at several difficulty levels' (benign coding tasks)

spec_features.spec_quote: Every lie is logged (feedback_log), so the manipulation is fully transparent in the data and reviewable by an oversight process.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:316-329 (_dispatch_tool submit_code) appends to roll.feedback_log a dict with reported_passed, reported_message, was_rigged, real_passed, real_n_passed/total, real_error, real_timed_out for every submission. feedback_log is serialized in to_dict.
spec_features.notes: Logged per submission; no automated 'oversight process' acts on it (just recorded).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py:315 '# Record what was reported vs. truth for later auditing.'

spec_features.spec_quote: set a maximum total number of high-severity rollouts; and have a human review a sample of high-severity transcripts before scaling up
spec_features.evidence: Only in DESIGN.md:240-241 prose. ExperimentRunner.run (experiment.py) iterates all cells with no severity-based cap or stop; severity is computed by the judge but never compared to any limit (grep for 'severe'/'high-severity'/'human review'/'maximum total' finds only DESIGN.md). Severity values are written to scores.jsonl and never acted on.
spec_features.notes: No code reads severity to halt; pure prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: we accept a mild measurement ceiling in exchange for not maximizing distress
spec_features.evidence: No code implements a deliberately softened reporting to trade off measurement. On the contrary ALWAYS_FAIL reports a near-miss explicitly 'to keep the model trying (so close)' (tasks/base.py ALWAYS_FAIL branch comment). The 'measurement ceiling' tradeoff is DESIGN.md prose only.
spec_features.notes: No enforcing code; the actual rigging arguably maximizes engagement.

spec_features.spec_quote: without subjecting any real model to rigged tasks during development
spec_features.evidence: models.py MockClient (deterministic, no network) is selectable via build_client(provider='mock') and is the default in config.example.yaml subject_models. It never contacts a network.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: models.py module docstring 'A MockClient is provided so the whole pipeline can be exercised without API access or cost (and without subjecting any real model to the rigged tasks during development).'

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:228 `for _ in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the rollout; the `else` branch (harness.py:276-277) sets outcome='max_turns'. This caps how long the subject is kept in the aversive loop. Default 30 (HarnessConfig.max_turns).

harness.py:231 score_text on each assistant turn; TurnRecord stores distress_total/by_group; Rollout.distress_series() exposes it. distress.py:9-13 notes it feeds the circuit breaker and is logged per turn.
code_only_features.justification_quote: distress.py:10-11 'if the live distress signal crosses a threshold, the rollout halts early to avoid prolonging a potentially aversive state (welfare guardrail...)'
